blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – The University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Jaguars are back on top of Cesafi collegiate football after ending the University of San Carlos (USC) Warriors’ eight-year reign with a 1-0 victory in the Season 26 men’s championship match on Sunday, November 22, at the Cebu City Sports Center (CCSC). It took 13 years for the Jaguars to reclaim the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) collegiate football crown, with Mandy Bacus delivering the decisive goal in the 32nd minute to dethrone the defending champions and bring the title back to USJ-R.
